src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: New flock request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: The request to add a flock; for now it is always placed in the default farm and house.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock status filter
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Says which flock statuses a lookup is allowed to return.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock label
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: The current display details of a flock, so lists of records can show flock names together.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock test data access
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Reads and writes sample flock data for the simulation setup; not available in production.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock lookup
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Lets other parts of the app find flocks by ID or name, reporting when a name matches several.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock contract
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Lists everything the rest of the app can ask the flock area to do, such as flock changes and bird movements.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Deaths recording
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Lets daily entries record bird deaths against a flock.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Bird movement request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: The request to record a manual change in bird count, such as a cull or a correction.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Edit flock request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: The request to change a flock's details.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Archive flock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Moves a flock out of active use while keeping its history.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Add flock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Adds a new flock to the farm.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: New flock check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Checks a new flock has valid details before it is added.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Mark flock depleted
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Marks a flock as having no birds left.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock finder
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Finds flocks by ID or name for other parts of the app.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock service
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Carries out flock requests such as adding, editing, archiving and recording bird movements.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Bird history storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Describes how bird movement history is saved; entries can only be added, with corrections made as new entries.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Flock storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Describes how flocks are loaded and saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Deaths recorder
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Turns deaths in a submitted daily entry into bird movement entries on the flock.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Reactivate flock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Brings an archived or depleted flock back into active use.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Record bird movement
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Adds a manual entry changing a flock's bird count, such as a cull or correction.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Bird movement check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Checks a bird movement has valid details before it is recorded.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Edit flock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Changes a flock's details.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.name: Edit flock check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/FlockM.description: Checks edited flock details are valid before saving.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.name: Bird movement types
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.description: The kinds of bird count change, such as deaths, culls and adjustments.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.name: Flock statuses
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.description: The stages a flock can be in, such as active, archived or depleted.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.name: Bird movement entry
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.description: One line in a flock's permanent bird history: deaths from daily entries, culls and manual corrections.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.name: Flock
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/FlockManage.description: A group of birds kept together, with its details, status and current bird count.
